svg.title: Ila lists drainage, transport, health and work to the listening square.
svg.desc: Seen partly from behind, Ila counts four practical promises on her fingers. Riju studies clinic workers, commuters, labourers, a contractor representative with a tender folder and a resident who has no personal route into the municipality.
